name: cumcm-global
title_zh: 数模竞赛跨阶段总控，按题目依赖自动分流
tagline_zh: 建模、可视化、论文各干各的，最后拼不上？它按题目依赖把任务分给对应专家，收尾统一查一致性，省掉你来回传话的半天。
tagline_en: Modeling, plots, paper each done in silos, then nothing fits? It routes subtasks by question dependency and does.
desc_en: Use when a CUMCM project spans multiple specialist stages, needs question-dependency routing, or requires final cross-artifact consistency review; not for a focused modeling, visualization, or paper-writing request.
why_zh: 不是又一个单步工具，而是把多阶段当流水线管：先拆题、再按依赖派活、最后统一审交叉引用。
why_en: Not another single-step tool—it treats the whole pipeline as one flow: decomposes the problem, dispatches by dependency, then.
limit_zh: 只接完整 CUMCM 赛题流程；单点建模/画图/写作请求会直接拒绝。需要各阶段技能已装好，否则只给路由建议不代跑。
limit_en: Only full CUMCM problem pipelines; single-stage modeling/plot/writing requests are declined. Requires stage skills pre-installed, else it only.
